name: cold iron
lore_descriptor: dark, cold to the touch even after long carry
unidentified_descriptor: dull, dark blade that feels too cold
first_pickup_chronicle: Cold iron. The fey will not love this. I am told the trick is in the hammering — cold, never hot. The dwarves who made this never blinked at a fire because they never lit one.
design_notes: Peak F30 spread 14 — mid-game specialist. Weapons-only (cannot be wrought into armor — mythological constraint: cold iron is forged without heat, plate would crack). damage_mult 1.10. The vulnerabilities list (demon) is INVERTED — the user takes EXTRA damage from demons when wielding cold iron, as the metal antagonizes them. Bold design: cold iron is a STRONG anti-fey/demon weapon but draws their fury. cannot_be_blessed flag — religious aversion in mythology.
